Also documents a much larger reference footprint (72-74 files per skill under agent-system/) than the delegation's scoped work list.

blocker.description: validate_core_system() loops `for skill in skill-researcher skill-implementer skill-planner skill-meta` and asserts each has a directory under skills/, logging [FAIL] Skill missing: <name> otherwise. Registered as a deployed script (manifest.json:226). Confirmed live-passing today against the deployed .claude/ tree; would flip to failing immediately upon deletion of the three target skill directories with no companion fix.

next_steps: Do not delete yet. A follow-up dispatch must (1) update validate-wiring.sh's validate_core_system() skill-existence loop to drop skill-researcher/skill-planner/skill-implementer (or make an explicit decision about what it should assert instead), and (2) re-plan the reference-cleanup scope against the full 72-74-file-per-skill inventory in the report (not just the 3 SKILL.md files + Skill-to-Agent Mapping table rows named in the delegation), before re-attempting this deletion.

memory_candidates.content: When deleting a core skill/agent from this repo, agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/validate-wiring.sh's validate_core_system() hard-requires skill-researcher, skill-implementer, skill-planner, and skill-meta directories to exist via a `[[ -d ... ]]` loop (line ~176). lint-routing-wiring.sh does NOT check this (it only validates routing_agents/routing_agents_hard values against agent files, never routing/routing_hard skill-name values against skill files), so a skill deletion can pass lint-routing-wiring.sh cleanly while still breaking validate-wiring.sh. Always grep validate-wiring.sh's skill/agent/rule existence loops before deleting any core-tier skill, agent, or rule file.

The plain (non-_hard, non-_agents) `routing` key in extension manifest.json files (e.g. nvim, email, formal, lean, present routing.plan.<type> = "skill-planner") is consumed only by command-route-skill.sh, which as of this check is sourced live in exactly one place repo-wide outside docs/templates: epidemiology/commands/epi.md's research stage (as a fallback default that its own domain routing always pre-empts). skill-orchestrate bypasses the skill-name router entirely, using command-route-agent.sh with routing_agents/routing_agents_hard instead. This makes most extensions' plain `routing` blocks effectively dead code post-command-deletion, but confirm per-repo before assuming it's safe to strip.
